# SZLHOLDINGS/canonical-formulas-v1 The **canonical SZL formula registry** — 21 pure, typed, no-IO Python formulas, the matching Lean 4 obligation theorems, and the Codex-Kernel governed-loop composer. ## Contents | File | What | |------|------| | `code/python/formulas.py` | 21 canonical formulas, each typed + pure + docstring-cited with PROOF-STATUS | | `code/lean/Formulas.lean` | One Lean 4 obligation theorem per formula (honest `sorry` where open) | | `code/python/composer.py` | Codex-Kernel governed-loop composer (hash-chained receipts + 4 hard-stop validators) | ## The Λ unification (canonical) Three divergent Λ definitions existed across the corpus. `lambda_aggregate` **canonicalises the weighted geometric mean** (D2) — the form the ouroboros Λ-gate runtime evaluates and whose axioms A1–A4 are in `Lutar/Axioms.lean`. (D1) unweighted is the uniform-weight special case; (D3) quantum-tilted is deprecated to the `gleason_quantum_lambda` sub-gate. ## Honesty (Doctrine v11) Every formula docstring carries a PROOF-STATUS: **PROVEN / SORRY / AXIOM / CONJECTURE**. We NEVER claim PROVEN where a Lean `sorry` remains. Λ uniqueness is a **CONJECTURE** (`Uniqueness.lean:120`). A2 = `IsHomogeneous`, A4 = `IsBounded`. DSSE signatures are **PLACEHOLDER** (Sigstore not wired into CI). Canonical Lean numbers (lutar-lean @ `c7c0ba17`): **749 declarations / 14 unique axioms / 163 tracked sorries** (112 baseline + 51 Putnam). ## Composer smoke 5 steps, Λ-aggregate ≈ 0.99729, `halted=False`, `replay_ok=True`. Four validators: `state_transition`, `drift_bounds`, `human_gate`, `axis_floor`. Any failure → HALT (HUKLLA). ## Sibling datasets - `SZLHOLDINGS/lean-proofs-v1` — full Lean theorem library (source of truth) - `SZLHOLDINGS/thesis-corpus-v18` — v18 chapters + 179 formal blocks - `SZLHOLDINGS/doctrine-v10-v11` — locked doctrine ## Citation **Cite this.** Part of the SZL Holdings *Ouroboros Thesis* (Governed Post-Determinism).
